==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|zle-mru|оболочка}}, from {{af|ru|оболочити|-ка}} or from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*obvolčьka}}, from {{af|sla-pro|*obvolka|*-ьka|nocat=1}}, from {{m|sla-pro|*obelťi}}, from {{af|sla-pro|*ob-|*velťi|nocat=1}}. Cognate with {{cog|pl|obłóczka}}.

Compare typologically {{m+|de|Bezug}} (< {{m|de|ziehen}} << {{m+|gem-pro|*teuhaną}} < {{m+|ine-pro|*dewk-}}), the term also functions as a suffix meaning ''case'' or ''cover'', as in {{m|de|Kopfkissenbezug}} (compare {{m|ru|на́волочка}}, {{cog|pl|powłoczka}}).

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|оболо́чка}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-оболочка.ogg}}

===Noun===
{{ru-noun+|оболо́чка|*|adj=оболо́чечный,оболо́чковый,оболо́чный}}

# [[cover]], [[envelope]], [[shell]]
# {{lb|ru|biology}} [[capsule]], [[outward]] [[form]]
# {{lb|ru|anatomy}} [[membrane]]
# {{lb|ru|technology}} [[jacket]], [[casing]]
# {{lb|ru|computing}} [[shell]] (''environment'')
